description: Source code implementing BIO pair functionality in OpenSSL/Boringssl, including buffer management, peer connection, and I/O control functions.

methods.name: bio_new
methods.description: Initializes a new BIO object with default buffer size.

methods.name: bio_destroy_pair
methods.description: Destroys the peer pair connection, resetting peer references and buffer states.

methods.name: bio_free
methods.description: Frees the BIO object and associated buffers.

methods.name: bio_read
methods.description: Reads data from the peer buffer, handling ring buffer wrap-around and retry logic.

methods.name: bio_write
methods.description: Writes data to the peer buffer, handling ring buffer wrap-around and retry logic.

methods.name: bio_make_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of connected BIO objects with specified buffer sizes.

methods.name: bio_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control commands for BIO objects, such as buffer size, pending data, and shutdown.

methods.name: BIO_new_bio_pair
methods.description: Creates a new pair of BIO objects with specified buffer sizes.

methods.name: BIO_ctrl_get_read_request
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes the peer has requested to read.

methods.name: BIO_ctrl_get_write_guarantee
methods.description: Returns the amount of space available for writing in the buffer.

methods.name: BIO_shutdown_wr
methods.description: Shuts down the write side of the BIO connection.
